outcome: Number of deliveries included in the metrics
cohort: Data from 275 hospitals from six states for NTSV metric and 81 hospitals from four states for SMFM metric were used.
finding: The SMFM metric was found to be a better tool for reducing cesarean birth rates in low-risk patients.
mod_finding: The study compared two metrics for cesarean birth rates, finding that the SMFM metric was more precise and better suited for quality improvement programs aimed at reducing cesarean births.
